entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3211922645854328832: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 23875: distance 27.397 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.012), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 27.397 +/- 0.329 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 36.2456 +/- 0.3575 mas (same row, RUWE 2.68), 101.4 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -88.481, -70.497 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3211922645854328832 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 3.439 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 23875: radius 3.439 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 43.469 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.035) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 7997 +/- 144 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 23875: effective temperature 7997 +/- 144 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.028).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 7,997 K and log g 3 (u1 0.362, u2 0.294): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 3 from 2016A&A...589A..83G; the 2 published values span log g 3 to 3.29, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness.
